scoring_justification: Transition pressures are final numeric arrays from numerical solvers; recomputation in the verifier is not feasible. Comparison against paper-reported values with generous tolerance and enforcement of the expected monotonic trend provides a faithful and robust verification.

hidden_assets.purpose: Paper-reported Solgasmix and dynamic model transition pressures
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Tables 1 and 2 of the paper (Balat et al., Appl. Surf. Sci. 133 (1998) 115‑123, doi:10.1016/S0169-4332(98)00193‑7)
hidden_assets.generation_method: Manual transcription from the paper tables; identical to the values written by the reference solve.sh.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact published reference values; the checker compares the agent's computed pressures against them.

schema.description: Ordered list of CO2 total transition pressure (Pa) for temperatures 1600, 1700, 1800, 1900, 2000, 2100 K.

outputs.description: Closed-system equilibrium transition pressures computed by free-energy minimization.

schema.description: Ordered list of CO2 total transition pressure (Pa) for temperatures 1600, 1700, 1800, 1900, 2000, 2100 K from the open-system dynamic model.

outputs.description: Open-system dynamic model transition pressures with mass transfer coupling.

output_contract.notes: Verification compares submitted arrays to paper-reported values (Table 1 and Table 2) with a generous tolerance to allow for differences in thermochemical databases and transport estimates. Both arrays must be strictly increasing with temperature.

steps.description: Compare agent's Solgasmix transition pressures against reference within 25% relative error. Also check array is strictly increasing.
Compare agent's dynamic model transition pressures against reference within 25% relative error. Also check array is strictly increasing.
